name: web-task-extension
description: Turn a browser chore you repeat into a Chrome / Edge extension. Describe it; it becomes steps (open, click, fill, wait, extract rows with fields across pages, download CSV / JSON or linked files) with user settings, and a Manifest V3 extension with a Run button popup, an options page, minimal permissions explained in plain words, and a store-ready zip. The manifest and code are validated (references, icons, permissions vs. steps, MV3 CSP, scripts, locales). No login automation.

description_i18n.en: Turn a browser chore you repeat into a Chrome / Edge extension. Describe it; it becomes steps (open, click, fill, wait, extract rows with fields across pages, download CSV / JSON or linked files) with user settings, and a Manifest V3 extension with a Run button popup, an options page, minimal permissions explained in plain words, and a store-ready zip. The manifest and code are validated (references, icons, permissions vs. steps, MV3 CSP, scripts, locales). No login automation.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把你在浏览器里反复做的操作变成 Chrome / Edge 扩展。描述一下流程，就会整理成步骤（打开、点击、填写、等待、跨页提取带字段的数据、下载 CSV / JSON 或链接文件）和设置项，并生成 Manifest V3 扩展：带“运行任务”按钮的弹窗、设置页、最小权限及通俗的权限说明，以及可上传商店的 zip。自动校验 manifest 和代码（引用文件、图标、权限与步骤是否一致、MV3 CSP、脚本、多语言）。不做自动登录。

title.zh-CN: 网页操作转浏览器扩展
